title: Argon
summary: Raleigh names Argon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Argon, on whom an Oracle conferred the Kingdome of Lydia. He came of a sonne of Hercules by Iardana. That sonnes name is a gap and was not filled. Hercules was not attached. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXV, §. IV, sig. 354a
